about_p1: Tharlam Academy is a sanctuary of learning located in the heart of the Buddhist community in Boudha-6, Kathmandu. We are home to approximately 85 students who receive a comprehensive education that bridges spiritual wisdom with modern academic studies.
about_p2: Our spiritual curriculum is led by our esteemed teachers, Principal Tenpa Gyalsten, Ghen Gyalsten and Ghen Karma, who guide our students in their traditional practices. To ensure a well-rounded education, Tharlam Academy also employs eight dedicated academic teachers, many of whom have supported our mission for over a decade.
about_p3: After operating for many years as a private institution, we have reached a major milestone. We have officially merged with the Manjushree Community School, a local institution that faced challenges following the COVID-19 pandemic. We are proud to announce that our institution is now formally registered and recognized as the Tharlam Manjushree Community School.
about_p4: We invite you to visit us to learn more about our community and our commitment to the next generation of learners.
mission_p1: Our mission is to provide exceptional facilities and a supportive environment for our students. We are dedicated to making them capable, confident, and prepared to navigate and contribute to the world around them.
vision_p1: Our vision is to provide a high-quality education rooted in the spiritual wisdom of the Sakya tradition. We believe in the power of 'Good Deeds and Good Karma,' guiding our students toward a life of purpose and integrity.
values_p1: We are deeply committed to preserving the Sakya tradition that has been passed down from generation to generation. Our values are built on the promise that as long as we are here, our sacred rituals and cultural heritage will continue to flourish.
community_p1: Our community is a warm, welcoming environment built on the foundation of monastic life. For many years, we have served as a home for our students and a place of help and support for all those in need.
principal_title: Principal of Tharlam Manjushree Community School
principal_quote_text: "Supporting a child’s education is like planting the seed of wisdom in this world. We invite you to walk this path with us—gently, generously, and with joy."
buddhist_inspiration_p1: "As a lamp lights another lamp, thousands of lamps can be lit from one. So too, wisdom shared spreads boundless benefit."

facilities_subtitle: At Tharlam Academy, we make sure our students have everything they need to feel at home while they learn and grow.
sports_p1: At Tharlam Academy, we believe that staying active is just as important as studying. After each month ends, we hold various sports activities to give our students a chance to exercise and have fun. Since every Saturday and Sunday are holidays, our students use this time to play their favorite games. Most of our young monks are very passionate about football and look forward to playing every weekend. To make things more exciting, we organize special Cup Competitions during important celebrations, such as Lhosar (New Year) or the birthdays of our Gurus. These events bring everyone together in a spirit of teamwork and joy.

welcome_p1: Nestled in the heart of Kathmandu, Tharlam Academy is more than just a school — it's a place where young minds grow with knowledge, compassion, and purpose. Inspired by Buddhist values and supported by a modern curriculum, we offer students a well-rounded education rooted in tradition and aimed at the future.
curriculum_p1: Tharlam Academy offers a unique curriculum spanning pre-primary to secondary levels. Our integrated approach empowers students by blending Buddhist traditions with diverse modern subjects.

legacy_subtitle: A Journey Through Centuries of Faith and Learning
roots_title: From Ancient Roots to New Horizons
roots_p1: Tharlam Monastery, a revered Sakya Buddhist institution whose full name is Shree Tharlam Sasang Namgyal Ling Monastery, traces its origins to 1436. It was originally established by Ga Rabjampa Kunga Yeshe in Kham, Eastern Tibet, beginning its long and significant journey as a center for Buddhist teachings and practice.
roots_p2: Centuries later, its legacy was faithfully rebuilt. In 1981, the monastery was re-established in Boudhanath, Kathmandu, Nepal, by Dezhung Rinpoche. This profound re-establishment fulfilled the specific instructions of his guru, Gaton Dorjechang, ensuring the spiritual and material continuity of Tharlam Monastery's enduring tradition for future generations.
monastery_img_alt: Photo of Shree Tharlam Sasang Namgyal Ling Monastery
academy_legacy_p1: Tharlam Academy, an integral part of Tharlam Monastery, was established in 1985 right here at the monastery. Its primary purpose was to introduce young monks to essential Western education, including subjects like mathematics, English, science, and various languages.
academy_legacy_p2: Significant improvements began in the early 2000s, enabling the full integration of a comprehensive Western curriculum. Today, Tharlam Academy proudly educates around a hundred students, preparing them for both monastic life and the broader world.

sports_overview_p1: At Tharlam Academy, sports play a vital role in the lives of our students. We are divided into **four houses** that compete in a wide range of events, including **football, kabaddi, kho-kho, volleyball, relay races**, and other recreational activities that refresh the mind and build physical stamina. Football is especially beloved—many consider it the most enjoyable and prestigious sport at our academy.
sports_overview_p2: Tharlam Academy often organizes special football tournaments on occasions like birthdays (“Birthday Cup”) and during Thuktea, a distinctive school holiday that’s more than just a break—it’s a cherished time to recharge. These tournaments foster spirited competition, camaraderie, and school pride.
sports_overview_p3: Such inter-house competitions not only keep students healthy and energetic but also sharpen their focus toward learning. In essence, Tharlam Academy’s emphasis on sports reflects its **holistic approach**, blending modern education, physical wellbeing, and traditional values.
white_house_p1: The **White House (Sapen House): Spirit of Purity**. The White House, also known as Sapen House, embodies purity, discipline, and precision. Students in White House are known for their meticulous approach to sports, excelling in activities that demand high levels of focus and technical skill. They represent the calm strength and unwavering dedication found in every Tharlam Academy athlete.
white_house_p2: Their focus is on perfecting form and strategy, leading to consistent performance and a deep understanding of their chosen disciplines. White House fosters an environment of quiet determination and refined athleticism.
yellow_house_img_alt: Yellow House students showing agility and Deshung House spirit
yellow_house_p1: The **Yellow House (Deshung House): Vibrant Energy & Agility**. The Yellow House, also known as Deshung House, radiates vibrant energy, enthusiasm, and exceptional agility. Members of Yellow House are often found leading the charge in fast-paced sports, showcasing their quick reflexes and dynamic movement. They bring an infectious positivity to every game and training session.
yellow_house_p2: This house encourages creativity in play and celebrates individual flair, while also valuing fair play and sportsmanship. Yellow House is about enjoying the journey, embracing challenges with a smile, and bringing a lively spirit to the academy's sports arena.
blue_house_img_alt: Blue House students demonstrating teamwork and Ghaden House spirit
blue_house_p1: The **Blue House (Ghaden House): Calm & Collaboration**. The Blue House, also known as Ghaden House, represents calm composure, strategic thinking, and unparalleled collaboration. Students in Blue House excel in team sports where communication and tactical play are key. Their ability to work seamlessly together makes them formidable opponents and supportive teammates.
blue_house_p2: Blue House emphasizes mutual respect, understanding, and the power of collective effort. They teach that true strength lies in unity and the ability to adapt as a cohesive unit, fostering a deep sense of camaraderie among its members.
red_house_img_alt: Red House students demonstrating endurance and Chime House spirit
red_house_p1: The **Red House (Chime House): Passion & Stamina**. The Red House, also known as Chime House, signifies passion, endurance, and boundless energy. Students in Red House are renowned for their incredible stamina and fighting spirit, making them powerhouses in long-distance and highly competitive events. They approach every challenge with intensity and fierce determination.
red_house_p2: Red House promotes courage, resilience, and the relentless pursuit of goals. Their strength is rooted in their ability to push past limits, inspiring all members to commit fully and never give up, embodying the true spirit of athleticism.
support_p1: At Tharlam Academy, we are deeply committed to fostering academic excellence, spiritual growth, and community values. However, maintaining our facilities, providing scholarships, and offering enriching programs requires significant resources. Your financial support, no matter the size, directly impacts the lives of our students and helps us continue our vital work.
support_p2: We believe in transparency and accountability. Every donation is utilized efficiently to directly benefit our students and enhance their learning experience. Your partnership is invaluable in sustaining our mission.

faq_subtitle: Find quick answers to common Tharlam questions.
faq_q_0: What is the purpose of Tharlam Academy?
faq_a_0: Tharlam Academy provides a holistic education for monks by integrating traditional Sakya Buddhist teachings with modern academic subjects like science, mathematics, languages, social studies, health science, and more. Its mission is to preserve the Sakya tradition while equipping monks for contemporary life.
faq_a_1: The academy is designed primarily for ordained monks from Tharlam Monastery. While lay practitioners may attend public teachings, formal academic enrollment is exclusively reserved for monks only.
faq_a_2: Tharlam Academy provides education up to grade 10, with the option to continue through class 11 and 12 for those monks who wish to pursue higher secondary education, supporting their path toward national exams.
faq_a_3: You can find donation options and details on our 'Support Us' page, which includes information on specific projects or general fund contributions.
faq_a_4: Tharlam Academy is located in Kathmandu, Nepal, operating as a part of the Tharlam Monastery complex.
